launchSequence: Fresh read-only baseline, source diff and credential/mode/account/Portal/D1 checks; stop on drift or missing live signing secret.
Obtain explicit production deployment/payment activation approval and approved method scope. Merge remains separately gated.

Create a private ephemeral config from the reviewed draft and current settings, preserving BREVO_API_KEY, TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY, assets configuration, all unrelated settings and existing domain/routes. Never use staging config.
During the approved change only: install distinct live donation secrets/binding, preserve existing secret bindings and vars, and deploy the reviewed source. Do not change DNS.
Enable the reviewed live webhook destination only once the correct signed handler is reachable. Verify real delivery, signature rejection, mode checks, current state and ledger reconciliation.

After approval, render unfunded live one-time/monthly Embedded Checkouts to verify key pairing, then expire them and verify genuine signed checkout.session.expired delivery and D1 reconciliation. No funded test donation or confirmed subscription. Check eligible-device wallets as available; no optional test delays.
rollbackSequence: After approval if launch fails: stop donation creation, restore the recorded prior production version(s)/traffic allocation and preserve original integrations/domain routes.
Do not drop or reset the live donation database or lose accepted events. Retain the live webhook and reconciliation path for any submitted or pending donations.
Reconcile all Stripe payments/subscriptions and delayed events, replay genuine failed deliveries as appropriate, and communicate pending status accurately. Code rollback does not undo a payment.
exclusions: Production workflow restricted to owner-approved exact branch/commit marker; no automatic main deployment added
PayPal flags remain disabled until separately approved and tested
